build_PerceiverIO: build a PerceiverIO transformer encoder with configurable depth, voxel size, and attention heads for 6-DoF manipulation
build_PerceiverActorAgent: build a PerceiverActorAgent with a PerceiverIO encoder, voxel grid, and Q-function for robot policy training
run_train: run the train function to train a PerAct policy on a robot dataset with specified path and template
run_eval: run the eval function to evaluate a trained PerAct policy on test data with optional visualization
run_main_cli: run the click CLI main function with flag t for training or e for evaluation on robot data
